plan.businessDomain: Home of the company's AI agents: agents, drafts, behavior and simulation live in the cm (collab messages) and are read and changed through it; this module owns the tool catalog of the app modules and the cm, which tools each agent has on, which people may not use a tool, and the execution summaries the cm sends.

entities.title: Agent
entities.description: An AI agent of the organization as the cm keeps it: definition, @name, who it talks to, on whose behalf it acts, whether it is on, who is responsible and its limits. Read and changed only through the cm.

entities.title: Agent draft
entities.description: A virtual employee the cm prepares from the admin's prompt, with its situation (preparing, ready, or refused with the reason); it is activated or discarded through the cm and stays in the cm.

entities.title: Agent behavior
entities.description: The current behavior of an agent in plain language (role and state texts in the cm) and the history of its changes with author, date and a one-line summary; changed or undone through the cm.

entities.title: Personal conduct
entities.description: How an agent that acts on a member's behalf behaves for that member, with the history of the member's own changes; kept and changed in the cm.

entities.title: Agent simulation
entities.description: A simulation run by the cm at two levels: what the agent can do for a person or role, and what it understands from a sentence. Nothing is saved.

entities.title: Tool
entities.description: One action of the tool catalog, from an app module or from the cm itself, placed in the module / subject / action tree with a readable name and description. Rebuilt when a module is created or a release arrives; a tool that leaves the release is marked removed and never deleted.

entities.title: Agent tool
entities.description: Whether one tool is on or off for one agent, and whether that choice was made by the admin or by the automatic choice; an admin's choice is never changed automatically.

entities.title: Person tool restriction
entities.description: A tool a given person may not use through any agent, marked by the company admin.

entities.title: Execution summary
entities.description: The summary of one finished execution of an agent sent by the cm: when, how long, cost, actions and their results, whether a person took over, and the link to the conversation. The same execution is never recorded twice.

entities.title: Organization user
entities.description: A person of the organization chosen from the platform user list: the person whose tools are restricted, or the person who called an agent in an execution.

relationships.description: Each agent tool choice refers to one tool of the catalog.
Each agent tool choice belongs to one agent of the cm (or its draft); the table stores the cm id.
Each restriction applies to one organization user.
Each restriction blocks one tool of the catalog.
Each execution summary is about one agent; the table stores the cm id.
The person who called the agent in the execution, when known.

undone.title: Undone

agent.title: Agent

person.title: Member

changeRequest.title: What do you want to change
changeRequest.description: What the member writes should change in how the agent behaves for them; sent to the cm, which updates only this member's conduct.

history.title: History of my changes

changedBy.title: Who

understanding.description: How the agent reads the sentence.

subjectName.description: Readable name of the subject of the tree path the sentence leads to.

actions.title: Actions

tool.title: Tool

explanation.title: Explanation

Rebuilt when a module is created or a release arrives; a tool that leaves the release is marked removed and never deleted.

agentChoices.title: Agent choices for this tool

capabilities.read.byId: Reads one tool by its id to show its name and description in the agent tools tree, the restriction list and the activity of an agent.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists the tools filtered by module, subject and situation to build the module / subject / action tree for the company admin and the members.
capabilities.locate.byText: Finds tools whose name contains the typed text, for the search box of the tools tree and of the people restrictions screen.
capabilities.count: Counts the available tools per module or subject for the tree headers.
capabilities.create: Adds a new tool when the catalog is rebuilt after a module is created or a new release arrives, upserting by tool key so a repeated rebuild adds nothing twice.
capabilities.update: Refreshes the readable name, description and release of a tool during the catalog rebuild.
capabilities.transition: Marks a tool removed when it leaves the release, or available again when it returns, moved only by the catalog rebuild.
capabilities.uniqueKey: Refuses a second tool with the same tool key, so each action of the release appears once in the catalog.
capabilities.transaction: Writes the whole catalog rebuild all or nothing, so the tree never shows half a release.
capabilities.agents.rebuildCatalog: Rebuilds the tool catalog from the actions of the app modules and the cm tools whenever a module is created or a new release arrives, with no screen open.
capabilities.agents.toolTree: Returns the catalog as a module / subject / action tree with readable names, for the agent tools scenario, the draft review and the people restrictions screen.

toolKey.title: Tool key
toolKey.description: Stable code of the action in the release, used to match the tool when the catalog is rebuilt. Never shown on screen.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Whether the action comes from an app module or from the cm itself.

moduleName.title: Module
moduleName.description: Module the action belongs to: the first level of the module / subject / action tree.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Subject inside the module: the second level of the tree.

name.title: Name
name.description: Readable name of the action shown in the tools tree and the restriction lists.

status.title: Situation
status.description: Whether the tool is in the current release or has left it. A removed tool is kept, never deleted.

details.title: Details
details.description: Readable texts and release information of the tool.

moduleTitle.title: Module title
moduleTitle.description: Readable name of the module shown in the tree.

subjectTitle.title: Subject title
subjectTitle.description: Readable name of the subject shown in the tree.

description.title: Description
description.description: Plain-language explanation of what the action does, shown next to its checkbox and used to suggest tools from an agent description.

releaseLabel.title: Release
releaseLabel.description: Release in which the tool was last found when the catalog was rebuilt.

addedAt.title: Added on
addedAt.description: When the tool first entered the catalog.

removedAt.title: Removed on
removedAt.description: When the tool left the release and was marked removed.

usedByAgents.title: Agents using it
usedByAgents.description: Number of agents that have this tool turned on.

transitions.description: The catalog rebuild finds that the action left the release and marks the tool removed; it stays in the catalog and is no longer sent to the cm.
The catalog rebuild finds the action back in a new release and makes the tool available again.

entities.title: Agent tool
entities.description: Whether one tool is on or off for one agent, and whether that choice was made by the admin or by the automatic choice; an admin's choice is never changed automatically.

tool.title: Tool of the catalog
tool.description: Each agent tool choice refers to one tool of the catalog.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Each agent tool choice belongs to one agent of the cm, or its draft.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads one tool choice by its id when the tools scenario toggles a checkbox; used by the company admin.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists the tool choices of an agent filtered by on/off and by who chose them, to build the tools tree and to answer the cm which tools are on; used by the admin screens and the cm request.
capabilities.listByForeignKey: Lists every tool choice of one agent, or of many agents at once for one tool, so the tree and the catalog refresh avoid one query per line; used by the admin, the draft review and the catalog refresh process.
capabilities.count: Counts the tools that are on for an agent, shown on the agent tools scenario; used by every organization member who opens the agent.
capabilities.create: Writes the choice for a tool the agent never had, when a draft is ready or a new tool arrives with the catalog, upserting by agent and tool so a repeated notice changes nothing; used by the processes.
capabilities.update: Turns a tool on or off for an agent and records who chose it; used by the company admin in the tools tree and on a draft, and, only on automatic choices, by the processes.
capabilities.uniqueKey: Refuses a second choice for the same agent and tool; enforced by the engine on write.
capabilities.transaction: Applies all suggested tools of a ready draft, or all new tools after a catalog rebuild, all or nothing; used by the processes.
capabilities.read.mdmRecord: Reads the admin who made a choice to show their name next to it, never an id; used by the tools scenario.
capabilities.agents.toolsForRequest: Answers the cm, for an agent and a person, the tools that are on and not removed, minus those the person may not use; used by the cm on each request with no screen open.

agentId.title: Agent
agentId.description: The agent (or its draft) of the cm this tool choice belongs to; the row stores the cm id, which is never shown on screen.

toolId.title: Tool
toolId.description: The action of the tool catalog that is turned on or off for this agent.

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Whether this tool is on for this agent; only tools that are on are sent to the cm.

choiceSource.title: Chosen by
choiceSource.description: Who made the current choice: the admin, or the automatic choice from the agent description. An admin's choice is never changed by the automatic choice.

details.title: Details
details.description: What else is kept about this tool choice.

decidedAt.title: Chosen on
decidedAt.description: When the tool was last turned on or off for this agent; filled by the system on each change.

decidedBy.title: Chosen by person
decidedBy.description: The company admin who made the choice; empty when the automatic choice made it.

values.title: New tool after a catalog update

automaticOrigin.title: Automatic origin
automaticOrigin.description: Which automatic step set the choice, when it was not the admin.

toolName.title: Tool
toolName.description: The readable name of the tool, read from the tool catalog, shown in the module / subject / action tree.

toolRemoved.title: Removed
toolRemoved.description: True when the tool this choice refers to has left the current release and is marked removed in the tool catalog; it is shown as removed and never sent to the agent.

entities.title: Person tool restriction
entities.description: A tool a given person may not use through any agent, marked by the company admin.

person.title: Restricted person
person.description: Each restriction applies to one organization user.

tool.title: Blocked tool
tool.description: Each restriction blocks one tool of the catalog.

capabilities.read.byId: Reads one restriction by its id when the checklist screen already holds it; used by the company admin.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists the tools blocked for the chosen person, filtered by person, so the company admin sees the checklist with the tools already checked.
capabilities.listByForeignKey: Lists the restrictions of one person, or of a tool, at once; also used when the cm asks which tools an agent has on that a given person may use now, to take the blocked ones out of the request.
capabilities.count: Counts how many tools are blocked for a person, shown as a badge next to the person in the restrictions screen for the company admin.
capabilities.create: Writes a restriction when the company admin checks a tool the person may not use through any agent.
capabilities.delete: Removes the restriction when the company admin unchecks the tool, so the person may use it again through agents.
capabilities.uniqueKey: Refuses a second restriction for the same person and the same tool, so checking a tool twice changes nothing.
capabilities.transaction: Saves all the checks and unchecks the company admin made on one person's checklist together, all or nothing.
capabilities.read.mdmRecord: Reads the organization user behind the restriction to show the person's name in the restrictions screen, never a technical id.
capabilities.agents.availableToolsForPerson: Answers the cm, for an agent and the person who called it, with the tools the agent has on minus the ones this person may not use; works with no screen open.

personId.title: Person
personId.description: The organization user who may not use this tool through any agent. Chosen from the organization users list.

toolId.title: Tool
toolId.description: The catalog tool this person may not use through any agent.

details.title: Details
details.description: What the module keeps about this restriction besides the person and the tool.

markedAt.title: Marked on
markedAt.description: When the company admin checked this tool as blocked for the person; filled by the system when the restriction is saved.

toolName.title: Tool
toolName.description: The readable name of the blocked tool, read from the tool catalog; never typed nor stored on the restriction.

toolPath.title: Where the tool sits
toolPath.description: The module, subject and action of the blocked tool in readable words, read from the tool catalog, so the checklist shows it in its tree.

toolRemoved.title: Tool removed from the release
toolRemoved.description: Yes when the blocked tool was marked removed in the catalog because it left the release; the restriction is kept and simply has no effect while the tool is gone.

entities.title: Execution summary
entities.description: The summary of one finished execution of an agent sent by the cm: when, how long, cost, actions and their results, whether a person took over, and the link to the conversation. The same execution is never recorded twice.

requester.title: Person who called the agent
requester.required: when the cm knows who called the agent

capabilities.create: Records the summary the cm sends for each finished execution, written by the execution recording process with no screen open.
capabilities.uniqueKey: Refuses a second summary with the same execution reference, so an execution that arrives again is recorded once.
capabilities.locate.byColumn: Lists the executions of one agent, or those called by one person, newest first by start time, for the activity scenario used by every organization member.
capabilities.listByForeignKey: Fills the activity scenario of an agent screen with the executions that point at that agent in one read.
capabilities.read.byId: Reads one execution to show its actions, results and conversation link.
capabilities.count: Counts the executions of an agent for the badge on its activity scenario.
capabilities.read.mdmRecord: Reads the organization user behind the person column to show who called the agent.
capabilities.agents.openConversation: Gives the link to the cm conversation of the execution so a member can open it from the activity list.

personId.title: Person who called the agent

tookOver.title: A person took over

conversationLink.title: Conversation link
conversationLink.description: Link that opens the conversation in the cm where this execution happened.

actions.title: Actions and results

toolName.title: Action

resultNote.title: Result note

toolRestrictions.title: Tools this person may not use

requestedExecutions.title: Executions this person requested
requestedExecutions.description: The agent executions in which this person called the agent.

capabilities.locate.byName: Finds a person by typed name in the people restrictions screen and the simulation person picker.
capabilities.listLinks: Shows a person's level-1 links, such as the company they are a member of, when explaining in simulation why a tool can or cannot be used.
